devdoc.details: Reads canonical intent data from the calling orchestrator. Whitelist admission is evaluated only when an intent is signaled; authorized cancellation and settlement callbacks are no-ops. All callbacks remain fail-closed. Deregistering an orchestrator with unresolved intents snapshotted to this hook permanently blocks their terminal callbacks, so governance must drain its intents before removing it from OrchestratorRegistry.

params._whitelistPolicy: Deposit-scoped whitelist policy used for intent admission.

onIntentCancelled(bytes32).details: A revert preserves the Orchestrator intent and aborts the corresponding Escrow unlock or prune operation.

params._intentHash: Identifier of the intent being removed without settlement.

onIntentSignaled(bytes32).details: The calling orchestrator stores the complete intent before invoking this callback, allowing the hook to read canonical intent data through `getIntent`. A revert rolls back intent creation and Escrow locking.

params._intentHash: Identifier of the newly stored intent in the calling orchestrator.

settleIntent((bytes32,address,address,ui.details: Called after fee transfers and before the net amount moves to the recipient or post-intent hook. The lifecycle hook receives no token allowance and cannot consume settlement funds. A revert rolls back the entire settlement, including Escrow release and fee transfers.

params._context: Intent identifier, token, recipient, pre-fee release amount, post-fee net amount, and settlement route.

devdoc.title: WhitelistLifecycleHook

constructor.notice: Creates a whitelist-only lifecycle hook over immutable policy and authorization dependencies.

onIntentCancelled(bytes32).notice: Resolves lifecycle-policy state for an intent being cancelled, expired, or pruned as an orphan.

onIntentSignaled(bytes32).notice: Validates and records lifecycle-policy state for a newly signaled intent.

settleIntent((bytes32,address,address,ui.notice: Resolves lifecycle-policy state for a successfully fulfilled or manually released intent.

userdoc.notice: Lifecycle hook enforcing persistent deposit-scoped whitelist admission without chargeback coverage. Open deposits remain unrestricted, while enabled whitelist policies reject every taker not currently allowed.
